comment_data.body:
This is not an issue with 'mini.icons', but with 'neo-tree.nvim' configuration. You can check that 'mini.icons' works as expected with `:=MiniIcons.get('directory', '.git')`. This is likely that 'neo-tree.nvim' doesn't use icons for directories by default (as described [here](https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim?tab=readme-ov-file#quickstart)). You seem to have to enable it explicitly [as described here](https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/1527).

Closing as not an issue with 'mini.icons'.

labels.description: Related to how upstream application works
labels.name: upstream

title: mini.icons - Directory icon not working with neo-tree.nvim
